evals.prompt: 帮我在开发板上执行 softbus_tool 的 GetLocalDeviceInfo 命令，把设备信息拿回来
evals.expected_output: SSH connects to the board, drives softbus_tool with menu inputs 0 and 8, captures and displays device info (DeviceName, IP, MAC, etc.)

evals.prompt: 我想通过 ssh 进入开发板的交互式 shell，像 hdc shell 那样，怎么操作？我在 Windows PowerShell 上
evals.expected_output: Provides the correct PowerShell ssh -tt command with the right key path and connection parameters

evals.prompt: 开发板重启了，sshd 挂了，帮我重新连上
evals.expected_output: Detects that sshd needs restart, uses hdc to restart it, then verifies SSH connectivity
